notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature, dealing 1 damage to Sprouting Phytohydra.
Sprouting Phytohydra triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
The Sprouting Phytohydra token enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the damaged Sprouting Phytohydra, dealing 1 damage to the remaining Sprouting Phytohydra.
Repeat from step 2.
